exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.cue: Hold the bell against your chest, elbows inside your knees at the bottom.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.cue: Bar on your traps, knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.cue: Elbows high the whole way, torso upright.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
exercises.cue: Long step back, the back knee brushes the floor.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.cue: Back foot on the bench, drop straight down without pushing off it.

exercises.name: Bench step-up
exercises.cue: Drive through the heel of the top foot, lower under control.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swing
exercises.cue: The hips throw the bell, the arms only guide it. Squeeze your glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Barbell deadlift
exercises.cue: Bar close to your legs, neutral back, push the floor away.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Push your hips back with soft knees until you feel your hamstrings.

exercises.name: Barbell hip thrust
exercises.cue: Upper back on the bench, chin tucked, one-second pause at the top.

exercises.name: Single-leg deadlift
exercises.cue: Keep your hips level, the free leg rises in line with your back.

exercises.name: Barbell bench press
exercises.cue: Shoulder blades pinched, bar to your sternum. Without a spotter, leave one or two reps in the tank.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.cue: Bench at 30°, elbows at 45° from your torso.

exercises.name: Barbell overhead press
exercises.cue: Glutes and abs tight, move your head out of the bar's path.

exercises.name: Arnold press
exercises.cue: Rotate your palms as you press, without arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.cue: Body in one straight line, chest almost to the floor. Stop two reps short of failure.

exercises.name: Bench dips
exercises.cue: Shoulders down and back, lower until your elbows reach 90°.

exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.cue: From straight arms to chin over the bar, no swinging.

exercises.name: Barbell row
exercises.cue: Torso at 45°, pull the bar to your belly button.

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row
exercises.cue: Knee and hand on the bench, drive your elbow toward your hip.

exercises.name: Gorilla row
exercises.cue: Two bells on the floor, hinge at the hips, row one side at a time.

exercises.name: Barbell curl
exercises.cue: Elbows still at your sides, no swinging from the hips.

exercises.name: Turkish get-up
exercises.cue: Slow, eyes on the bell; use a light one.

exercises.name: Farmer's walk
exercises.cue: Heavy dumbbells, shoulders back, short steps.

exercises.name: Hanging leg raise
exercises.cue: Raise your legs without swinging, lower them over two seconds.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.cue: Glutes and abs tight, don't let your hips sag.

exercises.name: Dumbbell thruster
exercises.cue: A front squat that ends in a press, in one movement.

exercises.name: Kettlebell clean and press
exercises.cue: Let the bell roll over your forearm instead of slamming your wrist.
